question: Do fixed-R resting take-profit limits improve net independent trade paths for the frozen OKX V1.7 12H confirmations?

entry.signal_close: confirmed_bjt = key_open_bjt + 12h; UTC 12H candle must be complete
entry.execution: exact 1H bar whose UTC open equals confirmation_ms, market at that bar open
entry.if_missing: retain no-entry status; never move entry to a later hour
entry.ema_source: V1.7 close-only EMA20/EMA50 recurrence, 12H only; current unfinished 12H is excluded

stop.signal: signals.csv reference_stop, original absolute touched-side 1.618 outside default
stop.control: matched parent's actual 1H-entry-to-reference-stop risk fraction applied to control open
stop.gap: stop-market exits at observed open when the open is beyond stop; otherwise exact stop price

control_matching.atr_feature: previous confirmed 12H Wilder ATR14 / previous close (V1.7 census definition)
control_matching.unmatched: write one explicit unmatched control event across every target setting with a reason

execution.processing: sequential by symbol and event batch

same_bar.same_direction_adverse_stop_ema_resoluti: nearer EMA/stop level, then adverse exit before opposite-side TP
same_bar.opposite_side_stop_take_profit_double_to: adverse first; if stop and EMA both touched, choose the nearer adverse level
same_bar.ambiguity_flag: only when no opening trigger occurred and adverse plus opposite-side TP are both touched
same_bar.epsilon: Pine: 8 * float64 epsilon * max(1, abs(EMA20), abs(EMA50)) / (2/21 - 2/51)
same_bar.strict_ema_cross: long low < EMA cross level - epsilon; short high > EMA cross level + epsilon

execution.data_gap: close at first next observed 1H open and mark gap; never backfill previous close
execution.stale_12h: terminate at earliest observable 1H open after the first missing 12H bar's expected close
execution.path_upper_bound: first post-entry opposite confirmed 12H EMA open, stale 12H observable open, first hourly gap open, or actual 1H series tail
execution.end_of_file: last observed 1H close, explicitly flagged series_tail_close
